query: We've agreed tenants get an email when a charge fails. I can see a few ways to wire that into src/billing/charge.js. What are our options before anyone writes a spec?
The goal is settled: jobs in src/scheduler/index.js must survive a worker restart. How should we do this? Lay out genuinely different approaches and compare them.
Offline edits have to merge cleanly when src/sync/pull.js runs. Only one approach has been written down and nobody has argued against it. Give me real alternatives side by side.
Product wants failed webhook deliveries retried. Which approach: a queue, a periodic sweep, or something we buy? Compare them against what the code does today.
Before we spec the session-timeout change in src/auth/session.ts, I want a few competing designs compared, including one where we build nothing at all.
The objective is fixed: duplicate messages processed by src/queue/consumer.js go to zero. Compare the alternatives for getting there before we pick one.
We know we want the rounding errors in src/utils/money.ts gone. What are our options, and which would you pick and why?
The notification goal in docs/design/notifications.md is approved, but there are at least three plausible ways to deliver it. Compare alternatives so we can choose.
Everyone agrees exports must stream instead of loading the whole file into memory. Give me several distinct approaches, each checked against the current code, then a recommendation.
We've decided the API needs rate limiting. How should we do it? What are the real alternatives, including the one that's cheapest to run for a year?
We're adding exponential backoff around chargeTenant in src/billing/charge.js; that part is decided. Write the spec for it.
We're considering a self-serve billing initiative but haven't agreed what success looks like. Help me pin down the objective first.
Make the scheduler better.
We chose advisory locks for the scheduler and it will be hard to undo. Record that decision along with the alternatives we turned down.
Show me two or three layout directions for the billing settings page so I can see which one looks right.
About the approaches you presented a moment ago: go with option 2.
We don't know whether the sync library can merge concurrent edits at all. Spike it quickly to find out before we commit to anything.
Implement the queue-based webhook retry we chose yesterday.
I'm not sure we should be building notifications at all, or what problem they would solve. Help me work out what the goal is.
Compare a sidebar against a tabbed layout for the orders summary screen. I want to see mockups of each.
